title: coreopsis occidentalis
intro: Coreopsis occidentalis, commonly known as the western coreopsis or tickseed, is a flowering plant native to the western regions of North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which contribute to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Coreopsis occidentalis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. These compounds work together to provide a range of benefits, from soothing digestive issues to calming skin irritations and promoting overall well-being.
